_comment: Never real people. Names are common given names joined with common family names. Every domain is invented with a "-fixture" label under .sa / .com.sa / .org.sa / .edu.sa / .net.sa (never .gov.sa) and returned NXDOMAIN on 2026-10-19. Phone numbers are invented; they are valid-shaped, so they are never dialled or messaged. IBANs, national IDs and card numbers are generated with valid checksums (mod-97, Luhn), because a detector that validates a checksum must be tested with values that pass it. Card numbers are synthetic test PANs (public test numbers or generated).
